verdict.rationale: Fathom documents self-serve API keys generated in User Settings, a list-meetings endpoint, dedicated transcript and summary endpoints that can return data directly, and webhooks that can include transcripts, summaries and action items. Official TypeScript and Python SDKs handle auth and pagination, and admins can reach all users' shared meetings by configuring View permissions. Missing for 10: no evidence of a direct pull endpoint for action items (they are shown only in webhook payloads), coverage is limited to meetings recorded by you or shared with your team, no machine-readable OpenAPI spec was found at the probed paths, and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration.
